lp.story.title: How Sparton works
lp.s1.title: You give us one thing: your shop's address.
lp.s1.body: Sparton reads your catalogue the way your customers see it. On Shopify and WooCommerce that is the shop's own product feed, so names, prices and stock are exact to the cent.
lp.s2.title: It finds the shops you actually compete with.
lp.s2.body: No list of URLs to paste. Sparton suggests shops that sell what you sell, and you confirm the ones that matter. Nobody is watched until you say so.
lp.s3.title: It matches their products to yours.
lp.s3.body: Your leather belt next to their leather belt, automatically. You see one row per product, with your price and theirs side by side.
lp.s4.title: Then it watches. Every move lands on the board.
lp.s4.body: Price cuts, price rises, sales with their "was" price, products that sell out or come back, and new products. Weekly on Free, daily on Pro, twice a day on Business.
lp.s5.title: And it tells you how sure it is.
lp.s5.body: Where a shop publishes its own product data, the number is exact and the tile is solid. Where Sparton has to read the page, the tile is hatched and the row says "extracted". You always know which is which.
lp.s6.title: On Sunday you get the week in plain language.
lp.s6.body: A short report of what changed and what it means for you. The numbers come from the comparison, never from the AI; the AI only writes the sentences, and every claim links to its evidence.
lp.plans.title: Plans
lp.plans.lede: Start free. Upgrade when it earns its keep. Prices exclude VAT; cancel any time from the dashboard.
lp.faq.title: Questions
lp.faq.a1: Sparton only reads pages a shop has made public, identifies itself honestly, respects robots.txt and waits between requests. It never logs in, never bypasses anything and never touches a checkout.
lp.faq.a2: On Shopify and WooCommerce shops Sparton reads the shop's own product feed: the price to the cent, including the "was" price of a sale and whether it is in stock. Where a shop publishes no feed, Sparton uses the product data in the page (schema.org) or, as a last resort, extracts the price from the page. Those rows are labelled "extracted".
lp.faq.q3: Does the AI make up numbers?
lp.faq.a3: No. Every number comes from comparing two readings of the same product. The AI only writes the sentences around those facts and may use no figure that is not in them. If the AI is unavailable you still get a correct report, just a plainer one.
lp.faq.a4: Weekly on Free, daily on Pro and twice a day on Business. The first check of a new competitor sets the baseline; changes appear from the second check on.
lp.faq.a5: Any webshop with public product pages. Shopify and WooCommerce shops give exact data through their feeds; other platforms, Lightspeed included, are read from the product data on the page and labelled accordingly.
lp.faq.a6: Any time, from the dashboard. No email, no call. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for.
lp.faq.q7: What happens to my data if I leave?
lp.faq.a7: You can delete your account at any time, which removes your shops, competitors, readings and reports.
lp.close.title: Next Sunday, know what moved.
